summary: Frontend visual regression pass for the FriendPlace butterfly icon fix. Verified via PIL bbox analysis on disk AND via live browser (mobile viewport 375x667) across Welcome, Login, Home, Games/Solitaire, Friends, Lounge and Onboarding. Every location now serves the SAME v2 asset and no stale old icon requests remain. Icon padding is now visually symmetric on all four sides.

png_bbox_on_disk.note: Butterfly is now vertically and horizontally centred within ~1px on the 1024px canvas. Previous iteration_53 measurement was 31%/20% top/bottom — asymmetry is fixed. Padding is closer to 20% each side rather than the ~27% predicted by main agent, but critically it is now EQUAL on all four sides (visually and numerically), which is what the request asked for.

verification_findings.old_asset_disk_check: friendplace-app-icon.png is deleted; only friendplace-app-icon-v2.png exists under /app/frontend/assets/brand/
verification_findings.code_references_check: grep across /app/frontend/src and /app/frontend/app shows all 6 files (BrandLockup, Header, ButterflyCardBack, lounge, friends, onboarding) require friendplace-app-icon-v2.png. Only one match for old filename is a code COMMENT in BrandLockup.tsx line 40 — cosmetic only, no functional impact.
verification_findings.regression_wordmark: BrandLockup renders 'FriendPlace' correctly next to icon on Welcome, Login, Home and Onboarding hero — no layout drift.
verification_findings.console_errors_during_flow: None (only pre-existing RN-web warnings about deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver — not related to this fix).

Root cause of prior asymmetry was that the v1 v2 PNG was regenerated without a strict PIL bounding-box crop, and 5 other files still `require()`d the old filename. Both were addressed by the main agent (PIL bbox-based re-render + sed sweep + delete of old PNG + Metro cache clear + expo restart). Verification confirms the fix is now in effect.
